files.content:
from flask import Blueprint, request, jsonify
from app.models.note import Note
from app import db

bp = Blueprint('routes', __name__)

@bp.route('/api/notes', methods=['POST'])
def save_note():
    data = request.get_json()
    if 'content' not in data or not data['content'].strip():
        return jsonify({'error': 'Note content is required'}), 400

    new_note = Note(content=data['content'])
    db.session.add(new_note)
    db.session.commit()
    return jsonify({'message': 'Note saved successfully', 'id': new_note.id}), 201

@bp.route('/api/notes', methods=['GET'])
def get_notes():
    notes = Note.query.all()
    notes_list = [{'id': note.id, 'content': note.content} for note in notes]
    return jsonify(notes_list), 200
```

    content = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=False)

    def __repr__(self):
        return f'<Note {self.id}>'

from flask import Flask
from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy

db = SQLAlchemy()

def create_app():
    app = Flask(__name__)

    # Corrected app configuration import
    from config.config import Config
    app.config.from_object(Config)
    
    db.init_app(app)

    # Ensure models are imported before db.create_all()
    from app.models.note import Note
    with app.app_context():
        db.create_all()

    # Correct blueprint registration
    from app.routes.main import main_bp
    app.register_blueprint(main_bp)

    return app

code_repository.readme_content:
# Simple Note-Taking App

An application that allows users to enter and save text on a single page.

## Features

- Text Input: A text box where users can type their notes.
- Save Notes: A feature to save the entered text for future reference.

## Setup

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python app.py
```

## Usage

Open http://localhost:5000 in your browser.
